title: useQueryForm
subtitle: Query + form + mutate combo

signature.code:
function useQueryForm<T>(config: UseQueryFormConfig<T>): UseQueryFormResult<T>

// import from "qortex-form-react/query"

content: Requires peer `qortex-query-react`. Fresh `data` comes from query refetch after invalidate — not from applying the save result. `save()` validates → `mutationFn(draft, meta)` → `resetDraft` on success. `useMutate` uses `queryKey: key` by default.

rows.name: key
rows.description: Query + form identity; default mutate invalidate key

rows.name: fetcher
rows.description: Omit for create-only; use initialData instead

rows.name: queryOptions / mutateOptions
rows.description: Pass-through options; mutateOptions.queryKey null skips invalidate

properties.name: error
properties.description: Mutation error preferred, else query error
